title: Robust Contrastive Learning against Noisy Views
role: A noise-tolerant replacement for InfoNCE, relevant only if this loop retrains a checker on very noisy latents
reads: Positive and negative pair scores from any encoder pair; tested on images, video-audio and graphs, with no diffusion latent or text-image pair
trained_on: CIFAR-10, ImageNet, Kinetics400, ACAV100M and TUDataset, with InfoNCE swapped for RINCE inside existing contrastive methods
score_enters: No gradient enters a sampler; RINCE is a training loss with settings q and lambda
unseen: no: no concept hold-out; video encoders are only transferred to UCF-101 and HMDB-51
headline: CIFAR-10 top-1 accuracy (%, higher is better) at label noise 0.8: 91.59 RINCE (q=1) against 87.11 InfoNCE, ResNet-50; ImageNet linear evaluation 70.0 against 69.3 for SimCLR
copy_or_avoid: Use only as a later retraining variant with q 0.1 to 0.5 and lambda 0.01; a large q would down-weight the noisiest latents this project needs, and it does not teach word-order binding (inferred)
model: none (ResNet-50, R(2+1)D-18 and graph networks; no generative model)
